name: ben-varrey
text: ben-varrey is the Manx term for the mermaid. The word belongs to the sea-folk lore of the Isle of Man. Her male counterpart in Manx belief is the dinny-mara. Together the two names cover the merman and mermaid pair of Manx coastal tradition.

okr.objective: Record ben-varrey as the Manx name for the mermaid.
key_results: Node gives the Manx term and its mermaid meaning.
Node names the dinny-mara as the male counterpart.
